explicit_validation.explanation: Both LLM-based feature tagging and human evaluation are conducted but they assess different aspects (LLM evaluates automatic AAE feature identification while humans evaluate chatbot performance metrics) and no quantitative comparison between the two methods is reported

prompts.notes: LLM used for automatic AAE feature tagging with test set of 90 texts containing 136 feature labels covering 30+ AAE features; Table shows LLM prompt for feature tagging but exact text not reproduced in provided excerpt

guidelines.notes: Detailed metrics provided (Table 1 shows 16 evaluation characteristics), evaluators use 5-point Likert scales, at least half of dialogues evaluated by two evaluators, evaluation interfaces shown in Appendix E

llm_only_criteria: AAE Feature Tagging (phonetic, morphological, syntactical, semantic features)
criteria_mapping.notes: LLM focuses on automatic linguistic feature analysis while humans focus on chatbot performance and user experience metrics; only Dialect Expression and Text Fidelity are somewhat related but evaluated through different methods
